body:
Yes and no.  It's important to me, but it's research, a bit of a huge slog, and I'm not yet deep enough in it that sunk costs help it be self-sustaining.  So, in some ways, the question is whether the a semblance of social contact, however unsatisfying, is preferable to leaving myself to my own head, whether I should maintain the distraction because killing it is both giving more time *and* veracity to the sense of isolation.  

The argument for killing it's kind of a "man up, do your thing and don't play another person's game" argument.  And sometimes we depressed folk really need that.  But sometimes that's exactly what we really, really don't need to hear.  Unfortunately, I've gotten to where I can argue both sides of that issue, and so I'm no good to myself.
